tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | SAP CX & ERP Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend e-commerce developer with 5+ years of professional experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) and SAP CX solutions. Proven expertise in integrating SAP Commerce platforms with SAP ERP, MDM, and PIM systems using RESTful OCC APIs, DataHub, and Hotfolders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer skilled in Java, Spring Boot, data flows, and production support across complex international enterprise projects.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: 6 to 8 years of overall SAP experience

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP CX / Commerce Developer
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of professional experience developing and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to submit my application. My background combines deep Java/Spring backend engineering with proven expertise in connecting SAP Commerce to SAP ERP and MDM environments.

bullets.label: SAP CX & ERP Integration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP ERP, and MDM systems using OCC REST Web Services, DataHub, and Hotfolders.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST APIs for headless commerce and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines to synchronize product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional capacity with international stakeholders to translate business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, and robust data models.

bullets.label: Platform Delivery & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), refactored database queries for improved latency, and provided high-tier production support.

cover_en.logistics: I am located in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required). I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026, making my earliest start date 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce integration background fits your team's needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your focus on integrating SAP CX solutions with enterprise SAP ERP infrastructure. Having delivered complex data pipelines, OCC REST APIs, and backend architectures for large enterprise clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I look forward to leveraging my techno-functional expertise to ensure reliable, high-performance platform integrations.
tailoring.motivation_short: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building OCC REST APIs and enterprise integrations between SAP Commerce, ERP, and MDM platforms, seeking to deliver strong technical solutions for your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of backend and ERP integration experience at Rockwell and Shell. I noticed your open SAP CX role and would love to connect and share how my integration experience aligns with your team's goals.
tailoring.offer: I will deliver immediate value by taking ownership of SAP Commerce backend flows, OCC REST API development, and enterprise integrations. Drawing on my hands-on CCv2 deployment and PIM/ERP data pipeline experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can ensure seamless platform delivery and production stability.
tailoring.insight: Integrating SAP CX platforms with SAP ERP backends requires robust API contracts and file-processing pipelines to keep catalog and customer data synchronized across environments; my hands-on work with OCC REST APIs, DataHub, and Hotfolders directly addresses these integration needs.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP CX / Commerce Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the SAP CX / Commerce Developer position. As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in Java/Spring, OCC REST Web Services, and integrating SAP Commerce with SAP ERP and PIM platforms.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, and available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can support your integration projects.
